content: Řeḥkamet iɛeffnen n Yuram
Yahucafaṭ igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes. Netta ittwanḍeř jar řejdud nnes di tendint n Dawud. Mmis Yahuram idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.
Aytmas, iḥenjiren n Yahucafaṭ tuɣa aten d Ɛazarya, Yaḥiyil, Zakariyya, Ɛazaryahu, Mixayil d Cafaṭya. Ina marra tuɣa aten d iḥenjiren n Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Israil.
Babatsen iwca asen aṭṭas n terzifin n nnuqart d wureɣ d řeqcuɛ iɣřan uřa d tineddam ifaryen di Yahuda, maca tageldit iwca i-tt i Yahuram, maɣar wanita tuɣa d amenzu.
Umi ikkar-dd Yahuram x tgeldit n babas uca imneɛ di tizemmar nnes, inɣa marra aytmas s ssif, uřa d ca n řḥukkam n Israil.
Yahuram tuɣa ɣares tnayen u-třatin n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem tmenya n iseggʷusa di Urcalim.
Netta yuyur deg webrid n ijeǧiden n Israil, am mammec tuɣa tegga taddart n Axab, maɣar yeǧis n Axab tedweř d tamɣart nnes. Netta igga min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin n SIDI.
Maca SIDI war ixs ad yareddeǧ Dawud di ṭṭweɛ n Řɛahd i igga ak-d Dawud, uca uřa umi d as tuɣa inna, aqa ad as iwc řebda ijj n řefnar zzat i tiṭṭawin nnes, i netta u i iḥenjiren nnes.
Deg wussan nnes ixtutteř Idum s uɣewweɣ zi sadu ifassen n Yahuda, uca ggin ijj n ujeǧid x yixef nsen.
Iɛdu Yahuram ak-d marra imeqqranen nnes d marra ikarruten nnes n umenɣi. Aqa ikkar s ǧiřet u iɣřeb x ayt n Idum inni tuɣa i d as dd-innḍen, i netta u i imeqqranen n ikarruten n umenɣi.
Waxxa amenni xtuttřen ayt n Idum s uɣewweɣ zi jar ifassen n Yahuda, ař ass-a. Di řweqt nni beɛda iɣewweɣ uřa d Libna, maɣar tuɣa Yahuda iḥeyyed x SIDI, AREBBI n řejdud nnes.
Igga Yahuram uřa d řegɛudi x idurar n Yahuda. Netta yarra imezdaɣ n Urcalim ad ssfesden ixef nsen s irebbiten nneɣni, wah, tuɣa iɛarn Yahuda ɣar man aya.
Tiweḍ-dd ɣares ict n tebrat n unabi Iliya, teqqar: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n babac Dawud: ‘Maɣar war tuyured x ibriden n babac Yahucafaṭ u x ibriden n Asa, ajeǧid n Yahuda,

maca tuyured x ibriden n ijeǧiden n Israil, uca tarrid Yahuda d imezdaɣ n Urcalim ad ssfesden ixef nsen s irebbiten nneɣni, deg webrid n farq-cɣeř n taddart n Axab, u minzi cek tenɣid uřa d aytmac zi taddart n babac, inni tuɣa icnan xak,
xzar, x uyenni SIDI ad cek iřqef s ict n tecti d tameqqrant jar řgens nnec d iḥenjiren nnec d temɣarin nnec d marra agřa nnec.
Cek simant nnec ad tewḍid deg ijj n řehřac n tekrict iqesḥen, ař dd ɣa teffeɣ ɛad tekrict nnec ɣar barra zi ssibbet n řehřac i ittduman.’”
SIDI issehweř x Yahuram arruḥ n Ifilisṭiniyyen d Weɛraben, inni izedɣen x uɣezdis n ayt n Kuc.
Nitni geɛɛden ɣar Yahuda, udfen ɣar tammurt u ksin marra agřa nni iǧan di taddart n ujeǧid, uřa d iḥenjiren nnes d temɣarin nnes, ařami war d as iqqim mɣir Yahuyaḥaz, amaẓuẓ n iḥenjiren nnes.
Awarni aya iwta i-t SIDI s yijj n řehřac war izemmar ad zzayes iggenfa.

Umi tuɣa netta ihřec ammu ass iḍfar umas, uca teɛdu řweqt ařami ɛdun tnayen n iseggʷusa, imsar, aqa takrict nnes teffeɣ-dd ɣar barra, u netta immut s řeḥřiq d ameqqran. Řgens nnes war d as issarɣ ca tmessi am ggin timessi i řejdud nnes.

Netta tuɣa ɣares tnayen u-třatin n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem tmenya n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Netta ifna, war xas indeb ḥed. Neḍřen t di tendint n Dawud, maca war iǧi deg imeḍřan n ijeǧiden.
